about.title: Front-End Developer crafting modern web experiences.
about.subtitle: A short story of me
about.p1: Frontend Developer specializing in React.js and Next.js, with hands-on experience building scalable, data-driven web applications from scratch. Experienced in developing complex booking platforms, social applications, AI-powered travel solutions,and interactive data-visualization dashboards.
about.p2: Strong focus on building maintainable and responsive interfaces using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Redux, and TanStack Query. Experienced in real-time applications with Socket.io, API integration, authentication flows, map-based interfaces, and handling large or dynamic datasets..
about.p3: My background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) strengthens my ability to understand complex data structures and translate them into clear, intuitive user experiences. I approach frontend development by understanding the underlying data   and business logic first, allowing me to build interfaces that remain reliable as applications grow in complexity.
